stemEn: A 1-week-old girl has occasional pinkish vaginal spotting but is otherwise well. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: Pseudo-menses في الأيام الأولى بعد الولادة قد تحدث بسبب withdrawal of maternal estrogen وهي finding طبيعي مؤقت إذا الطفل سليم ولا توجد red flags.
reasoningEn: Transient neonatal vaginal bleeding is caused by withdrawal from maternal estrogen exposure.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: It should resolve spontaneously within a few days.

stemEn: A 14-year-old girl has primary amenorrhea and short stature. What is the most useful diagnostic test for suspected Turner syndrome?
explanationAr: Short stature + primary amenorrhea يرفع الشك في Turner syndrome، والتشخيص يُؤكد بـ chromosome analysis/karyotype.
reasoningEn: Turner syndrome is confirmed cytogenetically by karyotype or equivalent chromosome analysis.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Evaluate associated cardiac, renal, hearing, thyroid and metabolic issues once diagnosed.

stemEn: A 14-year-old with amenorrhea has full secondary sexual characteristics but a low BMI. What is the most appropriate next step?
explanationAr: Low BMI يجعل functional hypothalamic amenorrhea/eating disorder احتمالًا مهمًا. التقييم يشمل pregnancy test وFSH/LH/estradiol وTSH/prolactin حسب السياق، إضافة لتقييم التغذية.
reasoningEn: Low energy availability can suppress the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis, so endocrine evaluation is appropriate.
incorrectOptionsAr: Karyotype أقل احتمال مع normal secondary sexual development؛ hymen assessment إذا هناك cyclic pain/obstruction؛ ultrasound قد يكون مساعدًا لكنه ليس التقييم الوحيد.
clinicalPearl: Always screen for eating disorder behaviors and bone-health risk.

stemEn: A 14-year-old girl has primary amenorrhea, monthly cyclic lower abdominal pain, Tanner stage V development and a suprapubic mass. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Cyclic pain مع normal secondary sexual characteristics وamenorrhea يوحي بوجود outflow obstruction. Imperforate hymen يؤدي إلى hematocolpos وقد يسبب suprapubic mass.
reasoningEn: Normal pubertal development plus cyclic pain and amenorrhea strongly suggests an obstructed menstrual outflow tract.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: A bulging bluish hymenal membrane may be visible on examination.

stemEn: A 5-year-old child is being evaluated for central precocious puberty. Which CNS lesion is a classic cause at this young age?
explanationAr: Hypothalamic hamartoma من أشهر CNS causes للـcentral precocious puberty في الأطفال الصغار، وقد يرتبط أيضًا بـgelastic seizures.
reasoningEn: Hypothalamic hamartoma is a classic CNS cause of very early central precocious puberty.
incorrectOptionsAr: Adrenal tumor يسبب peripheral precocious puberty؛ CNS tumors أخرى ممكنة لكن hamartoma هو الارتباط الكلاسيكي.
clinicalPearl: Look for gelastic seizures as an important associated clue.

stemEn: A child has gelastic seizures together with precocious puberty. What is the most likely underlying lesion?
explanationAr: Gelastic seizures هي laughing seizures، ووجودها مع central precocious puberty يعد clue قوي جدًا لـ hypothalamic hamartoma.
reasoningEn: The combination of gelastic seizures and precocious puberty is characteristic of hypothalamic hamartoma.
incorrectOptionsAr: Craniopharyngioma غالبًا يسبب endocrine deficits/visual symptoms وليس gelastic seizures كعلامة مميزة.
clinicalPearl: This is one of the most classic board associations in pediatric endocrinology/neurology.

stemEn: A child with McCune-Albright syndrome has precocious puberty. Which treatment should not be automatically assumed to work if the process is gonadotropin-independent?
explanationAr: McCune-Albright classically causes peripheral (gonadotropin-independent) precocious puberty، لذلك GnRH agonist لا يعالج المصدر الأساسي عادةً إلا إذا حدث secondary central activation. مفتاح الملف يحتاج مراجعة حديثة.
reasoningEn: GnRH agonists are effective for central precocious puberty, not primary gonadotropin-independent precocity from McCune-Albright syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى محفوظة، ولذلك لا يمكن اختيار علاج بديل من الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Treatment of McCune-Albright precocious puberty is sex- and manifestation-specific and often targets estrogen production/action.

stemEn: An adolescent has hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and loss of smell. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Anosmia/hyposmia مع hypogonadotropic hypogonadism هي hallmark لـ Kallmann syndrome بسبب فشل migration للـGnRH neurons والـolfactory structures.
reasoningEn: Kallmann syndrome combines congenital GnRH deficiency with anosmia or severe hyposmia.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: May also be associated with midline, hearing and renal anomalies.

stemEn: An adolescent girl has hirsutism and irregular menstrual periods. What diagnosis should be considered?
explanationAr: Hirsutism + persistent menstrual irregularity يرفع احتمال PCOS، لكن في adolescents يجب تطبيق criteria مناسبة للعمر واستبعاد أسباب أخرى للـhyperandrogenism وعدم الإفراط بالتشخيص مبكرًا بعد menarche.
reasoningEn: Persistent ovulatory dysfunction plus clinical hyperandrogenism suggests PCOS after excluding mimics.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Adolescent PCOS diagnosis should be cautious because normal pubertal anovulation can mimic it.

stemEn: A 14-year-old girl had menarche one year ago and now has irregular cycles, with normal growth and examination. What is the most likely explanation?

options.text: Anovulatory cycles from an immature hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis

explanationAr: في أول 1–2 سنوات بعد menarche تكون anovulatory cycles شائعة بسبب عدم نضج HPO axis. إذا لا توجد red flags فهذا غالبًا physiologic.
reasoningEn: Irregular anovulatory cycles are common soon after menarche as the HPO axis matures.
incorrectOptionsAr: Anorexia/hypothyroidism/PCOS تحتاج دلائل إضافية غير موجودة هنا.
clinicalPearl: Persistent marked irregularity beyond the expected pubertal window warrants evaluation.

stemEn: A 12-year-old girl has asymmetric breast development that began only a few months ago and no concerning mass or skin findings. What is the best management?
explanationAr: Breast asymmetry شائعة أثناء puberty وغالبًا تتحسن مع اكتمال development. في غياب red flags يكون reassurance والمتابعة مناسبين.
reasoningEn: Transient breast asymmetry is common during pubertal development and usually needs reassurance only.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Persistent major asymmetry can be reassessed after breast development is complete.
